jei.catgirl.info.cosmetic: Worn on top of armor, never instead of it. Put it in its slot in the cat panel to the right of your inventory: drop it there, shift-click it, or right-click with it in hand. Slots: ears, head, face, neck, paws, legs, feet, tail.
jei.catgirl.info.coats: Comes in 8 coats. A crafted piece takes the colour of its wool: black, white, gray, pink, orange gives ginger, lime gives neon. Siamese and Calico can't be crafted: the Fisher Neko gives a random piece in them for every 10 raw fish, and a Stray Neko now and then sells a rare tail.
jei.catgirl.info.dyeable: Dye it like leather armor: craft it together with any dye (several dyes mix).
jei.catgirl.info.cat_bed: Right-click to curl up, day or night: food comes back bit by bit, then Well Rested (+15% speed for a minute). Counts as sleep for phantoms.
jei.catgirl.info.cardboard_box: Right-click to hide inside: mobs can't target you and forget you. Sneak to climb out.
jei.catgirl.info.catnip: Grows wild in plains, meadows, forests and cherry groves. Plant it, speed it up with bone meal, right-click a grown bush to pick. Eating it gives Haste and a tumbly catnip high, and cats nearby get the zoomies.
jei.catgirl.info.yarn_ball: Throw it with right-click: cats run after it and bat it around.
jei.catgirl.info.raw_fish_sticks: Cook them in a furnace, a smoker or on a campfire.
jei.catgirl.info.milk_saucer: Clears only the harmful effects (milk clears them all) and gives the bowl back.
jei.catgirl.info.cat_food: 2 food, or 8 while you wear any of the three sets. Cats are tempted by it and can be tamed with it.
jei.catgirl.info.catnip_cookie: Haste and Jump Boost for 20 seconds.
jei.catgirl.info.squid_tentacle: Squids and glow squids drop 1-2. With wheat it becomes takoyaki.
jei.catgirl.info.bubble_tea: 4 food. Removes Mining Fatigue and gives the bottle back.
jei.catgirl.info.tuna_can: 5 food, very filling. Cats love it too.
jei.catgirl.info.stray_neko_spawn_egg: Stray Neko: lives in villages and trades ears, tails, collars and fish for emeralds, now and then a tail in a rare coat. Raw fish may win its trust: then it follows you, naps on cat beds and brings kittens.
jei.catgirl.info.fisher_neko_spawn_egg: Fisher Neko: fishes on beaches and riverbanks. Every 10 raw fish you bring earn a random fur piece (ears, tail, paws, leg warmers or slippers) in a rare coat: Siamese or Calico.
jei.catgirl.info.bakeneko_spawn_egg: Bakeneko: prowls dark forests at night and snatches what you hold, unless you wear Full Neko. In Full Neko, catnip buys your things back.
jei.catgirl.info.cat_spirit_spawn_egg: Cat Spirit: a rare ghost on quiet nights. Give it a small flower for Nine Lives until the next day: your next death is undone.
jei.catgirl.info.kitten_spawn_egg: Kitten: plays with yarn and boxes, and grows up into a Stray Neko that keeps its coat and its owner.
